reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes Al2O3 formation on an Al-free alloy; fluorine treatment alone cannot create aluminum where none exists, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clearly described with specific conditions, measurements, and a falsification criterion, but it tests an impossible mechanism, so the test itself is well-structured.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it relies on a fundamental compositional error (no Al in the alloy), so it cannot guide meaningful research on this question.
